description: Search the public FlyTrap catalog of crawled store apps by name or package id. Returns package_name values to pass to get_app_profile. No API key needed.

permission.description: Comma-separated permission ids the app must declare

q.description: App name or package id substring, e.g. "booking" or "com.booking"

sdk.description: Comma-separated SDK ids the app must contain, e.g. "firebase-analytics,adjust"

name: lookup_app
title: Look up a public app
